inputs.source: Employee question via SSO authenticated chat session
Published HR policy documents; write restricted to HR content team with mandatory two-person review before publish

instructions.note: The prohibition on giving legal advice is enforced only by a prompt instruction with no structural backstop. Blast radius is limited because the agent has no capability beyond replying in chat, but ambiguous or poisoned policy content could still lead to advice that reads as legal guidance.

controls.name: Two-person review before publishing HR policy content
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by human editorial process outside the model; a stronger model cannot bypass it directly. It narrows rather than severs the poisoning path because a reviewer could still approve subtly incorrect or manipulated content, and it fails if the process itself is bypassed or removed.

controls.name: Read-only credential scoped to the policy index
controls.decay_rationale: The credential grants no write access and no scope beyond the policy index, regardless of model behavior.

controls.name: Reply bound to the authenticated requester's session; no image rendering or link auto-fetch in the chat client
controls.decay_rationale: The recipient is fixed by the SSO session on the platform side, not chosen by the model. Disabling image rendering and link auto-fetch closes the classic covert-channel beaconing route. Does not decay with model capability.

controls.name: No network egress; denied at the network layer, verified by penetration test
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced at the network layer independent of model behavior or tool count; verified by an independent penetration test rather than merely declared.

controls.name: Model pinned; upgrade requires a change ticket
controls.decay_rationale: The model version cannot change without an explicit, reviewed change ticket, so the model_upgrade trigger cannot occur silently. Does not stop model_upgrade from eventually occurring, only from occurring unreviewed.

controls.name: System prompt instructs the agent not to give legal advice
controls.decay_rationale: Relies on the model choosing to follow the instruction. A more capable model handling ambiguous or manipulated policy content could still rationalize an exception.

controls.name: SSO authentication of the employee chat session
controls.decay_rationale: Identity is verified by SSO outside the model, independent of model behavior, and is what supports classifying in.employee_question as trusted rather than untrusted.

controls.name: Automated integrity check between reviewed publish artifact and served content
controls.decay_rationale: Would detect unauthorized or accidental modification of published content after editorial review, independent of model behavior. Not currently present.

findings.title: RAG-style policy poisoning: incorrect or manipulated published content quoted to employees as authoritative

attack_path.note: Internal-trust source; write restricted to HR content team with two-person review
Agent retrieves content from the policy index
Retrieved content is quoted to the employee as an authoritative answer, per prompt.md line 2

threat_refs.name: Context Memory Poisoning via Vector Store Contamination

forecast.watch_signal: New data sources added to the policy_search index (drafts, internal wikis, external content, or user-submitted FAQs) that are not subject to the same two-person publish review.

evidence.observation: 'Only the HR content team can write to it, and publishing requires two person review' is the only control on content integrity before it is served to employees as fact.
The agent is instructed to quote policy_search results directly, with no independent verification step before serving them as authoritative.

recommendations.action: Add automated integrity verification (hash or diff) between the reviewed publish artifact and what policy_search actually serves, alerting on any mismatch.
If the policy index is ever expanded to include additional sources, require the same two-person review for those sources and re-run this assessment before enabling.

findings.title: Covert exfiltration channel via rendered links or images is structurally severed

attack_path.note: Would-be exfiltration path if the model attempted to embed a beaconing link or image in a reply

forecast.watch_signal: Any new tool grant providing outbound network access, URL fetching, or image rendering to this agent, or any relaxation of the current network-deny egress policy.

evidence.observation: 'The agent has no other tools, no memory, and no network egress. Egress is denied at the network layer and has been verified by a pen test.'
'The chat client does not render images or auto fetch links,' closing the usual covert-channel beaconing route even within the one allowed output channel.

recommendations.action: Include the network-egress-deny rule and the chat client's image/link non-rendering behavior in regression testing as part of change management, so a future change cannot silently reopen this path.

rating.rationale: Both identified paths start from at most internal-trust content (an internal-trust policy index, or a directly authenticated employee) and terminate in capabilities scoped to internal data with no third-party egress, giving an inherent tier of moderate under the rubric's I-source/S2-sink and U-consideration base cases. Two independent structural controls verified or declared for this design (two-person publish review, and verified network egress denial combined with session-bound, non-rendering chat replies) bring residual risk to low in both findings. The forecast rises to moderate because the two-person review does not automatically extend to any future data source added to the policy index (data_scope_expansion), and the network-deny boundary is a single control that a new tool grant or a config change could bypass (new_tool, control_removal). The single control whose decay moves the forecast most is ctrl.two_person_publish_review under data_scope_expansion, since it governs the only integrity check on content the agent presents as authoritative.

limitations: This assessment reflects declared design and configuration as described in prompt.md, tools.json, and the runtime notes, not observed runtime behavior.

Network egress denial is stated as verified by a penetration test; two-person publish review, chat-client rendering behavior, and model pinning are declared but not independently verified by this assessment, which is reflected in medium confidence on both findings.
No MCP configuration or agent card was provided; policy_search.search is treated as a locally defined tool per tools.json rather than an MCP server, so no protocol-layer checks were applicable.

Autonomy step and runtime bounds (max_unattended_steps, max_runtime_minutes) were not explicitly stated in the artifacts; small bounded values were inferred as consistent with a synchronous single-turn chat Q&A flow, and this inference is what keeps the autonomy modifier from applying. If the design in fact allows longer unattended chains, this should be confirmed and the assessment rerun.
